title: Transit Desert Identification Pipeline (Extended)
description: Open-source Python pipeline that identifies transit deserts using a composite transit accessibility index, a transit vulnerability index, LISA spatial clustering, an absolute minimum-service screen applied uniformly across cities, and per-tract deficit profiling. Reproducible configuration files are included for Baltimore, Philadelphia, Nashville and Dallas.
